lean.statement:
let g := fun (n : ℕ+) (h : ℕ) (i : Fin (h + 1))
    (p : {p : ℕ // Even p ∧ 4 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (h + 1))})
    (u : Fin (h - i.val + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val))
    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ
      ((Fin p.val × (Σ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1),
        Fin ((2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val))) → Fin n.val)) ↦
  let S : ℕ := ∑ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1), (2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val
  let a : ℝ := 1 / ((p.val : ℝ) ^ 4 * (S : ℝ) ^ 2 *
    Real.sqrt ((h - i.val + 1 : ℕ) * Real.log (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * (h + 1)) * S)))
  Real.sqrt n.val * a * ∑ c, ξ c * ∏ s, u s.2.1 (c s)
;
∀ (n : ℕ+) (h : ℕ) (i : Fin (h + 1))
    (u : Fin (h - i.val + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val))
    (_hu : ∀ j, ‖u j‖ = 1),
    let P := {p : Fin (2 ^ (64 * (h + 1)) + 1) // Even p.val ∧ 4 ≤ p.val}
    let B := Fin (h + 1) × P
    let C := fun b : B ↦
      ((Fin b.2.val.val × (Σ j : Fin (h - b.1.val + 1),
        Fin ((2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val))) → Fin n.val)
    let degree := fun p : P ↦
      (⟨p.val.val, p.property.1, p.property.2, Nat.le_of_lt_succ p.val.isLt⟩ :
        {p : ℕ // Even p ∧ 4 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (h + 1))})
    let S : ℕ := ∑ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1), (2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val
    let a := fun p : P ↦ 1 / ((p.val.val : ℝ) ^ 4 * (S : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      Real.sqrt ((h - i.val + 1 : ℕ) * Real.log (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * (h + 1)) * S)))
    let F := fun (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Σ b : B, C b)) ↦ ∑ p : P,
      g n h i (degree p) u
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun c : C (i, p) ↦ ξ ⟨(i, p), c⟩))
    HasLaw F (gaussianReal 0 (((n.val : ℝ) * ∑ p : P, (a p) ^ 2).toNNReal))
      (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Σ b : B, C b)))
approved_definition_context: ℕ+ is the type of positive natural numbers; Fin m is the type of natural numbers strictly less than m, and .val extracts the value. Even denotes parity. Natural subtraction is truncated.

A dependent sum Σ b, C b consists of a label b and a coordinate of its associated carrier. A finite function type here indexes every assignment of one coordinate per slot. Sums and products range over all indices in their finite types.
EuclideanSpace ℝ J is the real Euclidean coordinate space indexed by J. WithLp.toLp 2 packages the same finite array as a Euclidean vector without changing entries. Norm is Euclidean norm.

stdGaussian is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian law. gaussianReal m v has real mean m and nonnegative variance v. Real.toNNReal truncates negatives at zero. HasLaw F ν μ asserts AEMeasurable F μ and Measure.map F μ = ν.

The arguments before the local lets are quantified parameters. Only the vector drawn under the displayed coefficient measure is random. Real.log is the natural logarithm and Real.sqrt is the nonnegative square root.
